title: Bea and the Creek Pebble Crown
youtube_title: Bea and the Creek Pebble Crown | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing the best pieces can make two smaller joys instead of one lonely pile.
summary: Bea collects the shiniest pebbles for a crown and then shares them with a visiting child who has an empty tin, so they can each make a pattern on the bank.
